detail.longDescription: 🤖 GhostAction evolves: after planting malicious GitHub Actions workflows, the crew now phishes open-source maintainers and hides an infostealer in a fake font file. OpenSourceMalware ties it to 94 compromised repos. Check your CI configs and recent deps. 🔗 https:// thehackernews.com/2026/10/ghos taction-attackers-plant-credential.html # CyberSec # Malware # SupplyChain # GitHub
